Understanding Sim Funded and Live Brokerage Contract Size

Updated this week

By reading this, it means you understand the following:

 

1) Evaluation contract sizes are not the same sizing you will receive in your Sim Funded and Live Brokerage Accounts.

 

2) Contracts are scaled down to meet margin requirements and account balance sizes.

 

3) Contracts in Sim Funded and Live Brokerage Accounts are smaller than your Evaluation or BluLive Accounts due to the change in capital you are trading with.

 

4) Contract sizing in Sim Funded and Live Brokerage Accounts can be adjusted by opening a support ticket below, once you grow your Sim Funded and Live Brokerage Accounts in profit.

 

Just because you had up to 14 Mini Contracts or 140 Micro contracts in Evaluation and Buffer Phases, does not mean you will have these sizes in your Sim Funded and Live Brokerage Accounts.
